contract: arcade-contract.js contains verbatim geometryCache through morphGeometry and hoverCallout from arcade.js. Full original arcade.js retained as an unloaded reference.
adaptation: Host open/close/save integration, storage namespace, back label and public exports; configurator VEs additionally select the greatest visible-area occupied facet after rotational momentum stops (4000 ms decay; central preview retains 1400 ms). Reduced motion skips coasting. Native geometry calculations, preview enumeration and renderer are unchanged. Opening accepts the six configuration values and original preview item count (0..2352). No physical model or score is generated.
spin_all: Header VE transfers actual pointer angular increments and release velocity to all eight side panes. Starting orientations are preserved; gesture response and 4000 ms decay are shared. Six setting panes select on stop; Explore and reserved panes do not auto-activate. No randomness.
momentum_revision: Configurator and shared-controller exponential decay increased from 800 ms to 4000 ms, preserving measured release velocity and the stop threshold. Five times the coast distance and decay duration for the same input, response and starting state. Subject preview remains at its native 1400 ms.
main_menu: Native Arcade foyer VE, front-first facet ordering at yaw pi/4, pitch asin(1/sqrt(3)), roll pi/4, camera distance 4.5. Above fourteen destinations, native expanded-room subdivision and compaction. All populations pass through verbatim facetTerritories with width 1; physical facets map to semantic destinations through faceItems. Native callout positions and complete-facet eligibility. Standalone address persistence/search and direct navigation remain host adaptations.
